notes.title: Mega City Force: V1.09 Patch
notes.content:
[h3]V1.09 Patch Notes[/h3]

Hello, Agents! We’ve just pushed a new update that introduces new minigames and collectibles, and addresses a wide range of important co-op and gameplay bug fixes.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added two minigames that can be unlocked by finding their corresponding collectibles, in celebration of the [b]upcoming big announcement[/b].
[*] Two new collectible tracks.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enabled Steam Remote Play Together for local co-op.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented collectible tracks from dropping.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “recent unlock” marks for both the Alien Blaster and the Spartan Laser would not appear, and therefore could not be removed.
[*] Fixed the current melee weapon not showing in the shop when using Cyborg with the extra weapon upgrade, due to the weapon limit maxing out at four.
[*] Fixed thrown blunt melee weapons missing the base melee damage from the agent who threw them.
[*] Fixed an incorrect sprite for the weapon chest in the tutorial sequence.
[*] Fixed incorrect text description for the Flak Jacket upgrade.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could still die or trigger a Second Chance upgrade (Flux Capacitor or Just A Dream) immediately after using a self-revive.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a sound effect to loop infinitely.
[*] Fixed a co-op bug where P2’s loadout could become identical to P1’s after using a Second Chance upgrade (Flux Capacitor or Just A Dream) or when checkpoints were enabled in casual mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Robot’s Defensive ability (Overclock) could break when used with the Defensive Charger upgrade.
[*] In co-op, Rookie’s Flashbang, Cyborg’s Magnetic Pulse, and Janitor's Giant Leap no longer stun your co-op partner.
[*] Fixed Automated Missiles not being treated as an automatic weapon.
[*] Fixed a very rare bug that could occur after trying out a dual-wielded weapon in the shooting range.
[/list]

notes.title: Mega City Force: V1.08 Patch
notes.content:
[h2]V1.08 Patch notes
[/h2]
[h3]Hello Agents!
[/h3]We hope you’ve been enjoying the last big update! We just pushed a new update to address some issues with save files and other bugs. 

[h3]Here are the full fixes:[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where save files were not being properly loaded, leading to the apparent loss of progress. (Note: Any recent progress made while this bug was active will unfortunately be lost.)
[*]     Fixed a bug that caused the game to get stuck when entering the Factory level.
[*]     Resolved an issue that locked the game when navigating back from the overview menu (tab menu) or other menus accessed from the station area.
[*]     Fixed the missing shot sound for the Twelve Blaster.
[*]     Fixed an issue in the Upgrade menu where the “quick access” option was not selectable when interacting with the station computer next to the Detective. This was caused by its proximity to the new co-op interaction on the Detective agent.
[/list]
[h3][b]About Mega City Force[/b][/h3]

Retrowave Skill-Based Action Roguelike about tough agents keeping peace the old-fashioned way. Choose your agent and dive into hardcore action against enemies and bosses using a huge arsenal and special abilities that will define your play style.

notes.title: Mega City Force v1.07: New Level and Local Co-op Are Here!
notes.content:
What’s New in v1.07?

🎮 Local Co-op Mode
For the first time, team up with a friend in local co-op! Select your agents, combine your strengths, and dominate the battlefield together.

🌊 New Level: The Docks
Explore a brand-new optional level packed with secrets, challenges, and opportunities to showcase your skills.

⚔️ Unlock New Content

New Agent: Meet Twelve, a powerful addition to your roster.
Legendary Weapons: Four new weapons added to the loot pool.
Visual Shaders: Customize your experience with retro-inspired shaders.
New Music Tracks: Eight synth-wave tracks to amplify the vibe.
Agent Skins: Two new unlockable skins for every character.
🔧 Modifiers and Upgrades
Experiment with modifiers that offer bonuses at the cost of penalties, creating unique gameplay opportunities. Plus, discover 12 new upgrades and take on 4 fresh contracts!

Improvements and Fixes
Improved contract tracking for easier progression.
Enhanced Skins menu for better navigation.
Automatic pause for disconnected controllers.
Enemy and weapon balance tweaks for smoother gameplay.
Combat Updates
Reduced Hazmat enemy HP for a more balanced fight.
Faster return speed for thrown melee weapons.
Mega City Force keeps evolving, and we’re thrilled to have you along for the ride.

Ready to jump back into action? Grab your gear, choose your agent, and bring justice to Mega City!

notes.title: Mega City Force | Janitor & Tunnels Update
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

Following the development of the game and according to the roadmap we have shared back when we first released the game, today we’d like to present our third free expansion of [b]Mega City Force[/b], this is the Janitor & Tunnels Update, it comes with a new agent with unique abilities, a new bonus level, more music, a new random event and some QoL & Bug Fixes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/b48f33eb92725a5d3a36c95b95e4ec8b6092213d.jpg[/img]

[h2]➕ New Content[/h2][list]

[*] [b]New optional level: Tunnels[/b]
[/list]Located after finishing the Japantown Level, similarly to other bonus levels, the entry to this level will be highlighted after defeating the bosses of Japantown at any difficulty level and any mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/e69259f55c59e7d0342299d3126f87df3d57bdd2.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New unlockable agent: Janitor[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/e0168af0dce1620eb45bb192c6e7c692bfaac6a2.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]An alternative random event has been added[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/9621b421f7f75116b1fc2041a6a6f43ea7cc1f14.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b] 2 new collectable tracks[/b]
[/list]


[h2]🛟 QoL improvements[/h2][list]
[*] Parked vehicles are now immune to melee weapons, so there is no need to worry about exploding cars while performing melee attacks near them.
[*] Now, when using a Reroll in the shop the upgrades in the cart will become locked, meaning that conveniently they will not reroll but also that they cannot be removed from the shopping cart.
[*] Purchasing the Body Armor upgrade in the shop, now will not only increase the max health capacity, but also increase the current HP by 5.
[/list]

[h2]⚖️ Balance[/h2][list]
[*] Decreased Factory boss money drop from 350 >> 300.
[*] Increased Prison boss money dropped from 330 >> 350.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Minor visual fixes like missing shadows and enemy skin variants.
[*] Hitbox size of Sawbot, Nailbot and Sparkbot slightly reduced to match better their sprite.
[*] Fixed some occasional rounding errors in Accuracy and Stamina percentage values of the weapons stats.

[b]Fixed incorrect sound effects:[/b]
[/list][olist]
[*] Fixed missing hit sound on cargo containers.
[*] Fixed missing hit sound on cargo trucks
[*] Fixed bug that prevented the Enforcer snoring sound from playing on the agent selection screen.

[/olist][list]
[*] Fixed incorrect skin picture displayed during the skin unlock animation when unlocking the tough skin for the Enforcer and Engineer agents.
[*] Fixed a bug with dual wielding weapons that would cause the ammo level to go under zero and become wrongly displayed as infinite.
[*] Fixed a bug where if the Extra Holster upgrade was acquired with cyborg bringing the weapon slots count up to 4 while having a melee weapon, the HUD indicator for the Melee slot would break and display an empty gap.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the tooltip from changing size when changing the weapon currently carried against the compared weapon in the ground.
[*] Fixed a bug that incorrectly displayed the damage per second stat of Blunt Objects when being compared. This was leading to situations where 2 weapons compared against each other impossibly showed as having less damage than the other.
[*] Increased the damage bar maximum in the weapon stats, since some melee weapons were far surpassing the bar maximum when factoring in the stats and upgrades from the player inspecting the weapon.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the boss in Factory (Level 2.5) to become stuck without attacking under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused corpses not to be always charred when killed by the Incinerator Unit weapon from the Robot.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]💖 Thank you! [/b][/h2]

Thank you for supporting [b]Mega City Force[/b], and I hope that you'll have a great time while exploring all the new stuff that been added!

notes.title: Mega City Force | Factory & Robot Major Content Update #2
notes.content:
[h1]G'day Agents![/h1]

The [b]Factory & Robot update[/b] is here after a delay, and it is packed with [b]new content[/b], [b]QoL improvements[/b] (we’ve fixed the melee system, read below to learn more!) and as usual, a bunch of bugs has been identified and fixed, so here’s the update! 🔥

[previewyoutube=yTkcvWD5XXM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🆕 What’s new?[/h2]

[h3][b]🏗️ Bonus Factory Level[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/cf4dcec59bd1c944680caa1956f53eda0da14eb8.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🤖 Robot Agent[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/00ff0336e19013de37501ed707130e28978e7c78.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⚔️ Reworked melee weapons to use a dedicated melee weapon slot[/b][/h3]

In other words, now they do not count towards the maximum you can carry but you can only carry one melee weapon at a time. Additionally, the [b]basic melee attack will now always try to use the currently carried melee weapon so the player can benefit from their better statistics[/b] without having to swap manually to them. Nonetheless, the player can still select the melee weapon normally and use it as its main combat weapon like before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/328cfb31689ebc27a6b7604a57e5fb1408a033b0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]💱 A new currency for shop re-rolls has been added[/b][/h3]
[i](This currency can be exchanged while in the shop in order to refresh the randomized shop contents)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/688a56c96c129049f4a121a4b444ab1904162db6.gif[/img]


[h3][b]❤️ QoL Improvements...[/b][/h3]

The game is shifting from hidden levels towards [b]Bonus Levels[/b]. We decided to do that to make [b]Bonus Levels[/b] more accesible for players, as we can see that a lot of people don't even know that those hidden locations exist in the first place. Additional levels are a part of the whole game experience, and we want to give an opportunity to as many players as possible to be able to access these parts of the game, and enjoy fighting [b]new bosses and unlock more agents[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/cbfc140f39f6224e2e4c4a60d9670e02c904ca71.gif[/img]

So now the entrances to [b]Bonus Levels are clearly indicated[/b] with the camera focusing on their entry. Now these levels will spawn multiple medkits on their entrance area; in addition, a re-roll die will be granted when defeating the boss on these levels.

[h3][b]🌆 And minor changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new random event
[*] Added 2 new collectible tracks.
[*] Added a new animation sequence to the game ending to clearly show when a new skin has been unlocked.
[*] Added an extra line for melee weapons, describing the effect they cause.
[olist]
[*] “Stun 1s” for Blunt Objects.
[*] “Bleed 4s” for Sharp Objects.[/olist][/list]
[b][h1]❗ But that's not all![/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/b7e020b8a74f6446880d3dd71becae22fb931d8f.png[/img]
[h3]🚨 Holiday siren is activated![/h3] 
The citywide [b]Steam Winter Sale[/b] will begin shortly, and we have opted in! Expect new decorations in the HQ and a whopping [b]20% discount on Steam[/b] starting at [b]21st December, 10:00AM PDT![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/d0f9fcfc2e4b8c70f73d7bf448ce8ee57b58441f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⚒️ And, of course, Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]The tracking of the bullseye combo was inconsistent and confusing for weapons that shoot more than one projectile at a time. The combo was reset or increased based on the outcome of the first impact of the projectiles of the attack. To fix these, 2 actions have been taken:
[olist]

[*] Now the successive projectiles of a burst are tracked individually (same as non burst projectiles) and each one will increase or reset the bullseye combo accordingly at the time of its impact.
[*] Now the simultaneous projectiles of a “multi shot” (like shotgun pellets) will increase the bullseye combo when any of them hits an enemy and reset the combo only when all of them have impacted and missed.
[/olist]

[*] Fixed an issue that tracked incorrectly the accuracy for the marksman contract with continuous attacks (Plasma guns and Electro-guns) making them track more hits than intended, even causing the percentage to go above 100%.

[*] Fixed an issue that considerably limited the fire rate of dedicated melee weapons.

[*] Firing will not be interrupted by any other inputs now; so Electro-guns, Particle beams and automatic weapons with charge time will not “restart” when the ability button is pressed, for example.

[*] Fixed a weird interaction with elements that drop to the ground and the parking lines in the MegaCorp level that caused these elements to move out of the parking lines, this was specially affecting gameplay when using weapons that shoot projectiles that drop to the ground like grenades.

[*] Fixed small misalignment of the Modern Machine Gun silhouette placement in the HUD.

[*] The damage (Max DPS) shown in the information/tooltip for weapons with attacks that cause effects like radiation, burn or bleed was displaying a higher value than the maximum damage per second they can actually output.

[*] Fixed a situation where the Captain sprite could stay white.

[*] Fixed a rare bug where some weapons (mostly laser weapons) will jam if dying under a very specific timing and then reviving with the self-revive. Swapping weapons fixed it, but one of these weapons specifically (Binary Laser) also blocked weapon swapping, invalidating the workaround.

[*] Fixed a visual bug that displayed a 6hp text popping up when it is actually 7hp if you pick a health pack while having the medical nanites upgrade.
[/list]

[h2][b]💖 Thank you! [/b][/h2]
Work on this update was quite hard, but nonetheless I am happy the way that it turned out. It is not the last update, so after a short coffee break, I will start working on the next update according to the roadmap. Again, thank you for supporting Mega City Force, and I hope that you'll have a great time while exploring all the new stuff that been added!

notes.title: Official Statement
notes.content:
[h2]Agents,[/h2]

Today, we want to share with you a substantial change that we believe is important to us. For context, [b]“Mega City Police”[/b] started from a retro-style action vision, the goal was to create a game that evokes nostalgia, transporting you back to the action films of the '80s and '90s era and for that we chose [b]“Mega City Police”[/b] to reflect this theme.

In the spirit of transparency and for a better future, we have decided to change the name to [b]“Mega City Force”[/b]. This decision was influenced by several factors:
  
[b][u]> The Essence of the Game:[/u][/b] “Mega City Force” better represents the core of our game – a group of old-school action heroes fighting for justice in the city called Mega City.

[b][u]> Name Complications:[/u][/b] Certain social events have unexpectedly cast a significant negative spotlight on the term “police” in connection with our game, in ways never intended.

[u][b]> Negative associations:[/b][/u] We acknowledge that some may connect the game to negative aspects such as police brutality, which prompted them to refrain from playing, we support the law, but not rigidity and violations. We care about people's feelings and don't want associations to cause negativity.

With all that in mind, we have one more important announcement to make.

[b]New Update — Factory & Robot Expansion[/b]

We promised the Factory & Robot update will arrive in Autumn, yet in the end this is going to be delayed until [b]December 21st[/b]. We'd like to apologize for the delay, but this allows us to properly layout a plan for the name change.
  
Now, we're reaching out to you, our incredible community. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please share your thoughts. We're confident [b]“Mega City Force” [/b]will maintain the action and immersive gameplay you adore. As we grow, expect more exciting adventures and updates as per our roadmap.

Over and Out!

notes.title: Mega City Police: V1.04 Patch
notes.content:
[h3]V1.04 Patch notes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/ed1d904bb5100094c35a1bcdc1f063f558d4fff8.jpg[/img]

Hello Agents! We just pushed a new update addressing some issues in controller support, added crosshair modifications and more! Here are the full changes!

[h2]🆕 QoL improvements[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Added additional colors to the starting weapon rarity text (and its star symbol) in order to set them apart based on their quality (For example, unlocked starting weapons are usually better than the default starting weapon).
[*] Show the rarity of weapons seen in the shop in the bottom right corner of their button itself for an easy overview.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/ab18b9653f2180007c4ad6923930b0e9d6c908f0.png[/img]

[*] Interface options gathered under a new options submenu.
[/olist]
[h2]🛠️ Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Corrected the bullseye contract text to properly reflect that the reward is $2 now.
[*] Fixed a regression issue that caused the timer for Speedster and Overachiever contracts to stop working.
[*] Fixed the incorrect count of unlocked skins for the Fashionista achievement.
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation for the Mercenary and the Outlaw agent info.
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation with D-pad not working in the shop.
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation on the initial streamer mode selection.
[*] Fixed the radio playlist from having an incorrect amount of tracks per page listed.
[*] Fixed a situation that sometimes made pickups become stuck inside the top walls, making it unreachable for the player.
[*] Fixed some weapons that were not giving you their ammo by simply walking over them.
[*] Fixed a bug that broke the game menu when pressing ESC during the difficulty unlock animation.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the game to occasionally stay stuck on the loading screen while playing in casual mode.
[*] Fixed the Engineer Drone behaving erratically when the player gets killed in the middle of using it while still having a Self-revive upgrade.
[*] Fixed a bug that potentially left enemies stuck with the bus prop recently added to the ruins level.
[/olist]
[h2]⚖️ Balance[/h2]
[olist]

[*] Reduced the aim speed of Visor’s laser (First boss) since now he is more aggressive and will chase you closer to stop you from staying put behind wall corners.

I hope this message finds you in high spirits, because I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to each one of you who joined us in our thrilling journey through the mean streets of Mega City Police. 🎮

notes.title: Mega City Police is finally OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, agents![/b]

Today we officially launch [b]Mega City Police[/b]. This is a moment that we all have been looking forward to, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you. After 5 years of development, the game is here with a plan for upcoming updates soon to come! 😉

[previewyoutube=lsYhwmKWqXo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]GRAB YOUR COPY WITH [b]15% OFF[/b]![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2259210/Mega_City_Police

Now we will commence a short brief and talk a bit about what you can expect from [b]Mega City Police[/b].

[h2]👮 Agents and Loadout[/h2]

Each of eight agents in Mega City Police offers a unique play style, encouraging players to experiment and find their favorite. Each agent has [b]two abilities[/b], which allow you to approach enemies differently depending on your skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/f4aca16852dad181ce0f0b26e5fc1a0571cda2d4.gif[/img]
And hundreds of guns, contracts, and upgrades at your disposal will help you to deal with all the scum in Mega City.

[h2]💪 Embracing the Classic[/h2]

[b]Classic mode[/b] is the backbone of Mega City Police. But you can’t jump into the action if you are a rookie and don’t have experience with Retrowave Skill-Based Action Roguelike games. Thus, the [b]Casual mode[/b] was included to ease a new agent’s entry into the genre. But if you go through casual levels like a hot knife through the butter – ramp up the difficulty and go to [b]Classic mode[/b] asap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/1037ed33dfdf884feb162cdcaafecfa144e471a4.gif[/img]

[h2]🎵 Music[/h2]

One of the standout features of Mega City Police is the presence of numerous talented artists from the retrowave and synthwave community. 

This is why we want to thank [b]TimeCop1983[/b], [b]Sublunar[/b], [b]DroidBishop[/b], [b]Midsummer Ex[/b], [b]NightCrawler[/b], [b]Pixelrebel [/b]and [b]Occams Lasers[/b] for their compositions! Their breathtaking music takes Mega City Police to the next level and adds a whole new energy to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/5b253423de884e5a61f340baac9cb3b4a8e90603.gif[/img]

[h2]⚔️ The Unyielding Challenge[/h2]

Remember – Mega City isn’t the safest place. And to deal with all its challenges you have to come up with plans, manage ammo and pay attention to the enemies you face. In Mega City, even the smallest mistake can bring you down.

The road to victory in Mega City Police is filled with countless obstacles and challenges. But do not fear, for your perseverance will be rewarded. As you overcome each challenge, you'll unlock new agents, weapons, and contracts that will aid you in your pursuit for justice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/1cf973ddb36999afe364eaaf8efe71dc5f32a5b5.gif[/img]

We understand that the game's difficulty can be daunting, but rest assured, we believe in you. We are proud to have created a game that truly tests your skills and pushes you to your limits.

[h2]🛣️ Future of Mega City Police[/h2]

After the release, you can expect us to support the game even further and bring more agents and levels to the game to shake up gameplay. You can even expect a new mode – couch co-op – in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/a299ae8f28743761e47154c1e273f579aca4a9f7.jpg[/img]

We poured our hearts and souls into Mega City Police. We share your love for the genre and your desire for an immersive and challenging experience. Your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping the game, and we are grateful for your unwavering enthusiasm.
So, grab your badge, load your weapons, and dive into the lawless world of Mega City Police. 

The city needs you, and it's time to show them what you're made of!

And if you enjoy art style and music – you can get [b]art book[/b] and [b]soundtrack[/b] and [b]Mega City Police[/b] in this Digital Collector's Bundle on Steam!

We're excited to announce the collaboration between [b]Dead Estate[/b] and [b]Mega City Police[/b]! These two great action rogue likes are now together in one bundle, bringing you a great hardcore stylish experience and lots of love <3

notes.title: Mega City Police | A Retro-Futuristic Devlog
notes.content:
Hey there, Officers! 

It’s been a while since we’ve shared our first demo on itch.io, such good days, we’ve received immense support from you guys and we’re still receiving it today especially when we introduced Mega City Police: Prelude, and we’re extremely grateful for it 💙

We just want to keep you posted on what’s going on inside the Mega City HQ and share what we've been working on these days to make some great updates and deliver the best retro meets cop experience that makes you nostalgic, and we're excited to share some of them with you. Here are some of the biggest changes we've made since our last demo build:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43573045/ca4928427b2396d9ef2a9e94274ad84a86a8f11e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features:[/h2]

[list][*] We have collaborated with [b]Droid Bishop[/b] and you can now listen to awesome music while you’re on your usual shifts as an officer cleaning the streets for justice!
[*] We've added a new weapon category to allocate all starting weapons and unlockable starting weapons. Plus, we've added 8 new weapons under the [b]“Particle Weapons”[/b] category. 
[*] We've added a noise system to improve the level's ground aesthetic, making the game even more immersive.
[*] Want to undo your selection? Now you can! We've added an undo selection functionality that allows you to go back to the cop selection menu instead of pausing the game.
[*] We've improved weapon balancing and now show the difference between two weapons stats with one bar followed by symbols [b]“+ | - ”[/b] instead.
[*] The player is now allowed to trigger automatic interactions like opening a chest or walking on top of a pickup even if on fire. Fire won't stop you now!
[*] Added a cutscene showing the city skyline and leading to the credits when beating the game. (Huge thanks to everyone involved)
[*] You'll now get messages for failed contracts at the end of the level. So don't worry if you don't succeed, we've got you covered![/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2][i]*A GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG*[/i]

[list][*] We've fixed a lot of bugs, including graphical bugs and incorrect configuration in weapons leading to a bad tooltip when inspecting it.
[*] We've reduced the chances of an enemy getting stuck on a prop significantly. Plus, we've added a system to return any enemy that has been pushed out of the map.
[*] We've finished abilities when the agent either dies or leaves the level, and we've fixed multiple bugs related to agent abilities.
[*] Plus, we've made multiple other fixes to improve the gameplay experience.[/list]

[h2]Aesthetics:[/h2]

[list][*] Trash added as ground noise in level 1, graffities on the walls of the first level, garbage cans and bags in the first level, and steaming drain grates in the floor of the first level. We've added a couple of taxis parked in the middle of the first level areas to enhance the city aesthetics. The game looks even more awesome now!
[*] We've modified and improved the sprites of multiple weapons to make them look more distinctive and unique.
[*] Cyborg's appearance has been reworked, making him look even cooler than before! More agents are being worked on as we speak (or read as you might notice)![/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]

[list][*] We've made multiple balancing changes to the game, including reducing the staticness of the Tengu miniboss in Japantown and increasing the melee range of the Oni miniboss in Japantown. 
[*] Plus, we've made Allied Robots and AIs react faster when called upon, like the engineer’s drone or the detective’s robots.[/list]

[h2]Misc:[/h2]

[list][*] We've lowered the time to show in-game tooltips and changed the notifications for completing a contract to be green instead of white for clarity. Plus, we've made other small changes to make the game experience even better!
[*] The player is now allowed to trigger automatic interactions like opening a chest or walking on top of a pickup even if on fire.[/list]

[h2]Sound Effects:[/h2]

[b]New sound effects implemented to enhance multiple animated sequences:[/b]
[list][*] New SFX along with the death sequence.
[*] New SFX along with the agent unlock sequence.
[*] New SFX along with the mission report sequence.
[*] New SFX along with the keys jingling in the difficulty unlock sequence.[/list]

[b]New weapon sound effects:[/b]

tags.feature: We have collaborated with [b]Droid Bishop[/b] and you can now listen to awesome music while you’re on your usual shifts as an officer cleaning the streets for justice!
We've added a new weapon category to allocate all starting weapons and unlockable starting weapons. Plus, we've added 8 new weapons under the [b]“Particle Weapons”[/b] category.
We've added a noise system to improve the level's ground aesthetic, making the game even more immersive.
Want to undo your selection? Now you can! We've added an undo selection functionality that allows you to go back to the cop selection menu instead of pausing the game.
The player is now allowed to trigger automatic interactions like opening a chest or walking on top of a pickup even if on fire. Fire won't stop you now!
Added a cutscene showing the city skyline and leading to the credits when beating the game. (Huge thanks to everyone involved)
You'll now get messages for failed contracts at the end of the level. So don't worry if you don't succeed, we've got you covered!

tags.bug: We've fixed a lot of bugs, including graphical bugs and incorrect configuration in weapons leading to a bad tooltip when inspecting it.
We've reduced the chances of an enemy getting stuck on a prop significantly. Plus, we've added a system to return any enemy that has been pushed out of the map.
We've finished abilities when the agent either dies or leaves the level, and we've fixed multiple bugs related to agent abilities.
Plus, we've made multiple other fixes to improve the gameplay experience.

tags.feature: Trash added as ground noise in level 1, graffities on the walls of the first level, garbage cans and bags in the first level, and steaming drain grates in the floor of the first level. We've added a couple of taxis parked in the middle of the first level areas to enhance the city aesthetics. The game looks even more awesome now!
We've modified and improved the sprites of multiple weapons to make them look more distinctive and unique.
Cyborg's appearance has been reworked, making him look even cooler than before! More agents are being worked on as we speak (or read as you might notice)!

tags.balance_change: We've made multiple balancing changes to the game, including reducing the staticness of the Tengu miniboss in Japantown and increasing the melee range of the Oni miniboss in Japantown.
Plus, we've made Allied Robots and AIs react faster when called upon, like the engineer’s drone or the detective’s robots.

[b]Officers, Captain here! [/b]

We are launching a [b]Public Playtest[/b] starting today, and we're looking for brave officers to join us in our fight against crime.
Our team has been working hard to create the perfect retro meets cop experience, and we need your help to make sure it's the best it can be. This playtest will allow you to explore the majority of the game, and take down some of the city's most corrupt criminals.
